ideas.pitch: An automated scaffolding CLI and web builder that lets solo developers instantly bootstrap ELU Store-compatible micro-SaaS applications with pre-configured auth, billing, and UI components.
ideas.problem_statement: About ELUBuild ELUBuild is the flagship solo product-building challenge by EduLinkUp . Over the course of the buildathon, individual builders pitch innovative software ideas, and once approved, build, document, and ship real-world SaaS applications from the ground up.
ideas.title: ELU Store Companion: Micro-SaaS Template Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the core goal of the hackathon—integration into the ELU Store platform—by making it trivial for solo builders to ship production-ready, standardized SaaS templates.

ideas.pitch: A tool designed for solo builders in 24-48 hour hackathons that parses your git repository and README drafts to instantly generate professional project documentation, feature breakdown, and demo-ready pitch transcripts.
ideas.problem_statement: Over the course of the buildathon, individual builders pitch innovative software ideas, and once approved, build, document, and ship real-world SaaS applications from the ground up.
ideas.title: DocuShip: Instant Documentation & Pitch Generator for Solo Devs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the explicit requirement in ELUBuild to not only build and ship, but thoroughly 'document' within a tight solo timeframe.

ideas.pitch: A companion utility and preview simulator that ensures solo builders meet all technical, metadata, and asset requirements before submitting their SaaS products to the ELU Store and Google Play pipeline.
ideas.problem_statement: Exceptional projects will be selected for integration into the ELU Store platform, with opportunities for direct deployment, hosting, and potential publishing on the Google Play Store on behalf of EduLinkUp.
ideas.title: EduLinkUp Mobile Submission Validator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a major friction point for the organizing team by pre-vetting app readiness, reducing integration headaches for ELU Store deployment.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight, drop-in telemetry and error-monitoring dashboard built specifically for solo developers to track real-world user engagement and uptime post-launch.
ideas.problem_statement: The mission of ELUBuild is to discover and empower solo builders to create sustainable, user-ready digital products.
ideas.title: SaaS Pulse: Real-World Usage & Health Tracker for Solo Founders
ideas.why_it_could_win: Proves sustainability and user-readiness beyond just a prototype, giving judges confidence that the product can survive in the wild.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered orchestrator that takes a GitHub repo and generates a structured, high-conversion explanatory video script and slide deck outline for hackathon submissions.
ideas.problem_statement: Submit your idea proposal (project name, problem statement, target users, proposed solution, anticipated tech stack, solo buildability feasibility, and an explanatory video link).
ideas.title: AgenticPitch: AI Video Script & Demo Reel Builder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly assists solo builders in creating the mandatory explanatory video link with professional polish, saving precious hours during a frantic build window.
